description: Reasoning as `<think>` in the content, split across chunks: `thought` events, kept out of the answer. The first turn calls ask_human with invalid arguments (a tool error goes back to the model), so the second request carries the history: the reasoning is sent back as `<think>\n…\n</think>` before the assistant content. The second call reports `reasoning_tokens`.
